notes: A Skynet_Integrated_Device (Fritz's drawing): the base of every Skynet Integrated Electric Kettle. The temperature probe in its Thermowell (front center) and the heating element (right side) are built in; the outlet (front bottom center) is a plain IP. Its Properties set the Interface, the Ports and the control (PWM, Duty Cycle, PID or Hysteresis) of both.
